mechanic.summary: Severing Axe applies a long Physical bleed to a random player.
mechanic.response: Use strong healing or a Physical-effect removal such as Blessing of Protection; a Paladin may pre-cast the immunity before the cast finishes.

provenance.description: Current spell record identifies Severing Axe as a Physical bleed, while the current Holy Paladin guide confirms Blessing of Protection as an encounter-specific removal.
Current Patch 12.1.0 Holy Paladin dungeon guide recommends Blessing of Protection for Severing Axe and notes that it may be cast before completion.
